blocks.text: Russian splits *go* four ways. **On foot** or **by vehicle**? And **one way, now** — or **around, habitually, there and back**?

items: I'm going to the shop (on my way now).
I often go to the theatre.
We're going to Moscow (by train, car…).
Каждое лето мы ездим на море.
Every summer we go to the seaside.

blocks.text: In the past, **ходил** / **ездил** means a round trip: *Вчера я ходил в кино* — *Yesterday I went to the cinema (and came back)*.
**Где?** (*where?* — at a place) takes the prepositional: *в школ**е***. **Куда́?** (*where to?*) takes the accusative: *в школ**у***. You'll meet both in the case sections.

exercises.q: *Смотри, мама ___ к нам!* (Look, Mum is coming over — on foot.)
Куда ты ___ ? (идти — where are you going?)
Я ___ на машине. (ездить, I drive regularly)
*Вчера я ___ в музей.* (went and came back)
exercises.why: A round trip in the past → **ходил**.
